mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS risk_score FROM app_h5_security_event WHERE created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND event_type IN ('USER_CHANGED', 'CLIENT_UID_CHANGED', 'RATE_LIMIT_HIT') AND device_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_id ) risk ON risk.device_id = d.id

where.if: AND ( d.latest_client_uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(d.latest_user_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.latest_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDevices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN last_seen_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeDay, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newDay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_h5_security_event WHERE created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND event_type = 'RATE_LIMIT_HIT') AS limitHitsDay, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) FROM app_h5_security_event WHERE created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND event_type IN ('USER_CHANGED', 'CLIENT_UID_CHANGED', 'RATE_LIMIT_HIT') AND device_id IS NOT NULL) AS riskyDay FROM app_h5_visitor_device

SELECT d.id, CONCAT(LEFT(d.device_token, 8), '***', RIGHT(d.device_token, 4)) AS deviceToken, d.latest_client_uid AS clientUid, d.latest_user_id AS userId, d.latest_ip AS ip, d.user_agent AS userAgent, d.anonymous_chat_attempt_count AS anonymousChats, DATE_FORMAT(d.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(d.last_seen_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastSeenAt, COALESCE(risk.risk_score, 0) AS riskScore FROM app_h5_visitor_device d
ORDER BY COALESCE(risk.risk_score, 0) DESC, d.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT event_type AS eventType, client_uid AS clientUid, user_id AS userId, ip_address AS ip, endpoint_group AS endpointGroup, detail, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM app_h5_security_event WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
